mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic recovery.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates severe labor market distress, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early recession regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output and lower corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO monthly change < 0 and the macro regime is 'early recession', or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1200 thousand units indicates a severe housing market contraction, reducing household wealth and consumer spending, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and elevated unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market weakness, reducing corporate profitability and investor confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth rate (measured as year-over-year change in GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 year-over-year growth exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production index below 100 (relative to 2017=100) indicates a significant contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
